brief:
Israeli settlers have razed Palestinian farmland across the West Bank's prime agricultural region, Al Jazeera English reported. The destruction accompanies violent settler expansion into Area A, territory nominally under Palestinian Authority control. The campaign has accelerated pressure on Palestinian farmers in one of the occupied territory's most productive zones.

The destruction represents an escalation of settler violence beyond previously targeted areas. Farmland destruction threatens Palestinian food security and economic livelihoods in a region already facing resource constraints. The campaign demonstrates settlers' systematic efforts to acquire Palestinian land through intimidation and property damage.
dek: Palestinian farmland razed as violent Israeli settler expansion spreads into Area A of the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian farmland in West Bank's agricultural heartland
